description: This Java class 'DocsController' is a minimal REST controller in a Spring Boot application that handles GET requests to '/docs'. It responds with a JSON message indicating that the API documentation UI is disabled and suggests using the '/health' endpoint for availability checks.

classes.name: DocsController
classes.description: A REST controller providing a basic endpoint /docs that returns a disabled documentation message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /docs, returning a JSON response indicating that documentation UI is disabled, with HTTP status 410 GONE.
